accounts.i-heading-levels.why: Modal titles are h1, h2 or h3 with no relation to their place, and the share sheet has no heading, so the exposed heading structure misstates the visual one.

accounts.i-rule-cards-hidden-period.why: An invisible period ends each rule card button's accessible name, so screen readers read text the label does not show.

accounts.i-safe-form-labels.why: A switch is named by a code key, a listbox by an internal id, two inputs and the linked-account kebab buttons have no name, and an amount field is named only by its placeholder.

accounts.i-tabs-not-tabs.why: The tab bars, Autopay Edit links and Last Month control are divs or a p with click handlers and no tabindex, so Tab never reaches them; they also have no tab or button role.

billpay.i-date-input-label.why: The Invoice date input's accessible name is 'Select due date', which does not contain its visible label and names the wrong field.

billpay.i-manage-link.why: The Manage link has the paragraph's color and no underline, so nothing but its position tells it apart from body text; axe's link-in-text-block checks this.

billpay.i-pay-dialog-name.why: An invisible overlay's h2 is exposed as the first heading on every pay-flow step, so the heading structure differs from what is shown.

billpay.i-unlabeled-controls.why: The row delete button has no name, the Inbox to Paid tabs are DIVs with no role, and the amount input is named only by its placeholder.

books.i-fake-disabled-save.why: Save is drawn as disabled but exposed as enabled, so its visible state and its programmatic state disagree.

books.i-frequency-aria.why: The listbox exposes Annual as selected while the combobox shows Monthly.

cards.i-modal-heading-semantics.why: The Edit card limits title looks like the other dialogs' h2 titles but is a span with no heading role.

cards.i-subscription-actions-unlabeled.why: The Subscriptions row's icon link and buttons have no text, aria-label or title.

home.i-chips-as-menuitems.why: Tab-like filter chips are menuitems outside any menu with no selected state; the avatar and widget kebab buttons also have no name.

invoicing.i-unlabeled-controls.why: The Customers row edit and request buttons have no name, and the branding swatches are named by internal ids.

payments.i-icon-links-a11y.why: The send and transactions icon links have no text, aria-label, title or SVG title.

settings.i-unnamed-row-buttons.why: The API token row menu buttons have no text or aria-label.

transactions.i-category-name-label.why: The Create category name input has no label, placeholder or aria-label.
